sample.input_transform: EIA daily/weekly values are averaged to months then transformed to MoM. BLS industry PPI inputs are used as published (NSA) MoM with calendar-month fixed effects; they are not relabelled as seasonally adjusted.
sample.vintage_policy: Current source vintages are collected. The model is time-ordered and has no target look-ahead in its training windows, but an archival release-vintage panel is not yet retained. Results therefore cannot activate a pathway.

relationships.availability_rule: The contemporaneous EIA daily input is aggregated over the reference month and is available before the following-month CPI release; industrial production is lagged one month because its release can follow the CPI release.
EIA reference-month energy and BLS PPI reference-month data are treated as available before the following-month CPI release. Industrial production is lagged one month.

requirements_before_any_promotion: archival release-vintage input histories and release-calendar availability audit
